faq.q: How do I check where my application stands?
faq.a: Every application shows its current stage on My Applications, and the detail page has the full timeline. Status changes also arrive as notifications.

faq.q: Can I apply to more than one role?
faq.a: Yes. Each application is reviewed independently by that team, and applying to one role has no effect on the others.

faq.q: How do I reschedule an interview?
faq.a: Open the interview and choose Request reschedule. Pick the slots that work for you and recruiting confirms within one business day.

faq.q: When do I get the video link?
faq.a: The join link appears on the interview 15 minutes before the start time. Dial-in details are in the calendar invite.

faq.q: Which documents do you need from me?
faq.a: A resume is required. Some roles also request a cover letter, portfolio or a short questionnaire. Anything outstanding is listed under Documents.
Yes, from the row menu on My Applications. Withdrawn applications stay visible for your records but cannot be reopened, so you would need to reapply.

faq.q: How long do you keep my data?
faq.a: Applications and interview records are kept for two years after a decision, as required for equal-opportunity reporting. You can export or delete your data in Settings.

faq.q: Who do I contact about an accommodation?
faq.a: Reply to your recruiter in Messages. Accommodation requests are handled confidentially and have no bearing on your candidacy.
